acceptanceCriteria: In the default plan, a ticket with `requiresPool == P` is SELECTED only while the count of earlier selections requiring P is below P's currently free eligible members. Otherwise it is DEFERRED with `RESOURCE_COLLISION` and blockers `[P]`, and it **does not count** against `maxActiveAttempts`. It is not BLOCKED merely because the plan was not run with `--pool`.
A fixture with capacity 16, 8 live, 6 pool-waiting and 28 lane-free tickets selects 8 lane-free tickets (reproducing the #584 numbers).
Plan output reports the number of resource-deferred selections, per pool. This is additive, under the profile decided in D1.
`claim-next` and explicit claim still admit exactly what the plan selects (CAL-V0-008/014 parity test). The `--pool`/`--stage` plan path and pool exclusions (CAL-V0-065) are unchanged.
When member state is unobservable (no `pools.json` proof), the plan reports pool availability as NOT_OBSERVED and defers. It never selects on an assumption.
body: Filed 2026-10-05 from GitHub issue beamfall/corvint#584 (orchestrator triage T584, read-only code survey on origin/main 019f958a; findings are code-read inferences, not runtime). - Type FEATURE, **P1**: lane-free throughput was capped at about 2 for hours, and the window is the planner's own decision. Finding 2 also shows the default plan misreports every requiresPool ticket as BLOCKED. - Labels: `agent-memory`, `ideas`, `github584` - touchPaths: `.corvint/change.cem.json`, `.corvint/changes/`, `docs/TASKS-EXTERNAL-AGENTS.md`, `docs/specs/INDEX.json`, `docs/specs/README.md`, `docs/specs/REQUIREMENTS.tsv`, `docs/specs/corvint-tasks-agent-leases-v0.md`, `internal/tasks/cli/dispatch.go`, `internal/tasks/cli/plan.go`, `internal/tasks/transaction/plan.go`, `internal/tasks/transaction/plan_resource_test.go` - Acceptance (option (a), see D1): 1. In the default plan, a ticket with `requiresPool == P` is SELECTED only while the count of earlier selections requiring P is below P's currently free eligible members. Otherwise it is DEFERRED with `RESOURCE_COLLISION` and blockers `[P]`, and it **does not count** against `maxActiveAttempts`. It is not BLOCKED merely because the plan was not run with `--pool`. 2. A fixture with capacity 16, 8 live, 6 pool-waiting and 28 lane-free tickets selects 8 lane-free tickets (reproducing the #584 numbers). 3. Plan output reports the number of resource-deferred selections, per pool. This is additive, under the profile decided in D1. 4. `claim-next` and explicit claim still admit exactly what the plan selects (CAL-V0-008/014 parity test). The `--pool`/`--stage` plan path and pool exclusions (CAL-V0-065) are unchanged. 5. When member state is unobservable (no `pools.json` proof), the plan reports pool availability as NOT_OBSERVED and defers. It never selects on an assumption. - Note: this does not help tickets that lack `requiresPool`. The remedy there is V1-0754/0758/0759 plus setting the key, so the operator guide must say so.

completion.reason: Every acceptance criterion is met: resource-aware deferral with RESOURCE_COLLISION, the #584 16/8/6/28 fixture, per-pool deferral counts under the D1 pool-cap decision, claim parity, NOT_OBSERVED without pool proof. Limit: tickets without requiresPool do not benefit (follow-up filed). Evidence: docs/build-log/2026-10-05-v1-0786-resource-selection.md at 618680492cf8. Verified at 618680492cf8 (merge of beamfall/corvint#574); CI on #574 green (go-product shards, go-interop, doc-gates). make gate, live store qualification and batch dogfood rebinding are NOT_RUN.
